execute_code <<'PY'
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

df = pd.read_csv('/Users/wzq/workspace/line_loss_data.csv')

print("=" * 70)
print("                         🏭 整体线损概览")
print("=" * 70)
print(f"  数据时间范围  : {df['date'].min()} ~ {df['date'].max()}")
print(f"  站点数量      : {df['station_code'].nunique()} 个")
print(f"  总记录数      : {len(df)} 条")

total_supply = df['supply_kwh'].sum()
total_sale = df['sale_kwh'].sum()
total_actual_loss = df['actual_loss_kwh'].sum()
total_theo_loss = df['theoretical_loss_kwh'].sum()
overall_loss_rate = (total_actual_loss / total_supply) * 100
overall_theo_rate = (total_theo_loss / total_supply) * 100
management_loss = overall_loss_rate - overall_theo_rate

print(f"\n📊 总体电量和损耗")
print(f"  {'总供电量':<14}: {total_supply/10000:>10.2f} 万 kWh")
print(f"  {'总售电量':<14}: {total_sale/10000:>10.2f} 万 kWh")
print(f"  {'总实际损耗':<14}: {total_actual_loss/10000:>10.2f} 万 kWh")
print(f"  {'总理论损耗':<14}: {total_theo_loss/10000:>10.2f} 万 kWh")
print(f"  {'超额损耗(管理线损)':<14}: {(total_actual_loss-total_theo_loss)/10000:>10.2f} 万 kWh")
print(f"\n🏆 关键线损率指标")
print(f"  {'综合线损率':<14}: {overall_loss_rate:>8.2f}%")
print(f"  {'理论线损率':<14}: {overall_theo_rate:>8.2f}%")
print(f"  {'管理线损率(差值)':<14}: {management_loss:>8.2f}pp")
print(f"\n📈 线损率分布统计")
rates = df['actual_loss_rate']
print(f"  {'均值':<14}: {rates.mean():>8.2f}%")
print(f"  {'中位数':<14}: {rates.median():>8.2f}%")
print(f"  {'标准差':<14}: {rates.std():>8.2f}%")
print(f"  {'最高':<14}: {rates.max():>8.2f}%")
print(f"  {'最低':<14}: {rates.min():>8.2f}%")

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("                         🔴 异常类型分布")
print("=" * 70)
tag_stats = df.groupby('abnormal_tag').agg(
    记录数=('actual_loss_rate', 'count'),
    站点数=('station_code', 'nunique'),
    平均线损率=('actual_loss_rate', 'mean'),
    理论线损率=('theoretical_loss_rate', 'mean'),
    平均供电量_kwh=('supply_kwh', 'mean'),
    平均负载率=('avg_load_rate', 'mean'),
    平均用户数=('user_count', 'mean')
).round(2)
tag_stats['占比'] = (tag_stats['记录数'] / len(df) * 100).round(1)
tag_stats = tag_stats[['记录数', '站点数', '占比', '平均线损率', '理论线损率', '平均供电量_kwh', '平均负载率', '平均用户数']]
print(tag_stats.to_string())

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("                        🔶 各异常类型超额损耗")
print("=" * 70)
loss_by_tag = df.groupby('abnormal_tag').agg(
    总损耗_kwh=('actual_loss_kwh', 'sum'),
    总理论损耗_kwh=('theoretical_loss_kwh', 'sum'),
    总供电量_kwh=('supply_kwh', 'sum'),
    记录数=('actual_loss_rate', 'count')
).round(0)
loss_by_tag['超额损耗_kwh'] = loss_by_tag['总损耗_kwh'] - loss_by_tag['总理论损耗_kwh']
loss_by_tag['超额损耗占比'] = (loss_by_tag['超额损耗_kwh'] / (loss_by_tag['超额损耗_kwh'].sum() + 0.001) * 100).round(1)
loss_by_tag['管理线损率_%'] = (loss_by_tag['超额损耗_kwh'] / loss_by_tag['总供电量_kwh'] * 100).round(2)
print(loss_by_tag.to_string())

total_excess = total_actual_loss - total_theo_loss
print(f"\n  总体管理线损(超额损耗): {total_excess:>10,.0f} kWh = {total_excess/10000:.2f} 万 kWh")
print(f"  占供电量: {total_excess/total_supply*100:.2f}%")

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("                     📐 按变压器容量等级分析")
print("=" * 70)
cap_stats = df.groupby('transformer_cap_kva').agg(
    站点数=('station_code', 'nunique'),
    记录数=('actual_loss_rate', 'count'),
    平均线损率=('actual_loss_rate', 'mean'),
    理论线损率=('theoretical_loss_rate', 'mean'),
    最高线损率=('actual_loss_rate', 'max'),
    最低线损率=('actual_loss_rate', 'min'),
    平均负载率=('avg_load_rate', 'mean'),
    平均供电量_kwh=('supply_kwh', 'mean'),
    平均用户数=('user_count', 'mean')
).round(2)
cap_stats = cap_stats.sort_index()
print(cap_stats.to_string())

print("\n各容量等级异常比例:")
for cap in sorted(df['transformer_cap_kva'].unique()):
    sub = df[df['transformer_cap_kva'] == cap]
    high = sub[sub['actual_loss_rate'] > 4]
    ratio = len(high) / len(sub) * 100
    print(f"  {cap:>4}kVA: {len(high):>2}/{len(sub):>2} = {ratio:>5.1f}% 异常")

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("                     📅 每日综合线损趋势")
print("=" * 70)
daily = df.groupby('date').agg(
    综合线损率=('actual_loss_kwh', lambda x: round(x.sum() / df.loc[x.index, 'supply_kwh'].sum() * 100, 2)),
    平均实际线损率=('actual_loss_rate', 'mean'),
    平均理论线损率=('theoretical_loss_rate', 'mean'),
    总供电量=('supply_kwh', 'sum'),
    总损耗=('actual_loss_kwh', 'sum')
).round(2)
print(daily.to_string())

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("                    🔥 高线损站点 TOP 10 (>4%)")
print("=" * 70)
high_loss = df[df['actual_loss_rate'] > 4].sort_values('actual_loss_rate', ascending=False)
print(f"共 {len(high_loss)} 条记录\n")
cols = ['station_code', 'date', 'supply_kwh', 'sale_kwh', 'actual_loss_rate', 'theoretical_loss_rate', 
        'transformer_cap_kva', 'avg_load_rate', 'abnormal_tag']
print(high_loss[cols].head(10).to_string(index=False))
if len(high_loss) > 10:
    print(f"\n  ... 还有 {len(high_loss)-10} 条记录")

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("                    📋 定性总结与治理建议")
print("=" * 70)
print(f"  1. 综合线损率 {overall_loss_rate:.2f}%，处于合理水平，但略高于理论值 {overall_theo_rate:.2f}%")
print(f"  2. 管理线损（超额损耗）{management_loss:.2f}pp，约 {total_excess/10000:.2f} 万kWh")
print(f"     其中表计故障和窃电嫌疑是主要原因")
print(f"  3. 异常率高达 50%，需要重点关注")
print(f"\n  治理优先级建议：")
print(f"     🔴 第一优先：表计故障台区 → 现场校验/更换计量装置")
print(f"     🟠 第二优先：窃电嫌疑台区 → 用电检查+反窃电专项")
print(f"     🟡 第三优先：三相不平衡台区 → 负荷均衡调整")
print(f"     ⚪ 长期：优化变压器容量配置（小容量台区线损偏高）")
